description: Reserved Matters Application relating to the layout, scale, appearance, access and landscaping for the development of Plot 43B comprising: Purpose Built Student Accommodation (Sui Generis Use) inclusive of student rooms as either self-contained studios or within a shared unit, internal communal student amenity space, associated cycle and refuse storage space, and bus driver welfare facilities (Sui Generis Use) to be provided within a building ranging from ground plus 9 to ground plus 20 storeys; and the provision of external amenity areas and surrounding public realm. The application is submitted pursuant to Conditions 1.3(v) and 2.1 in relation to the Phase 5D sub-phase of planning permission F/04687/13 (dated 23rd July 2014) for the comprehensive mixed use redevelopment of the Brent Cross Cricklewood Area. The application is accompanied by an Environmental Statement of Compliance.
site_name: Brent Cross Cricklewood Regeneration Area, North West London
